# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from config/settings.yaml and the Settings models. Do not edit: run `make docs-config`. -->

Every tunable lives in `config/settings.yaml`. Any value can be overridden with an environment variable named `VG_<SECTION>__<KEY>` (two underscores between levels), for example `VG_LLM__PROVIDER=mock`. Secrets are never stored in the YAML: put them in `.env` (see `.env.example`).

## `app`

| Key | Default | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app.name` | `VendorGuard AI` | text |  |
| `app.environment` | `local` | local \| ci \| demo \| prod | local \| ci \| demo \| prod |
| `app.log_level` | `INFO` | DEBUG \| INFO \| WARNING \| ERROR | DEBUG \| INFO \| WARNING \| ERROR |
| `app.log_json` | `false` | true/false | true = JSON lines (servers / CI) |
| `app.doctor_timeout_s` | `3` | number (> 0.0) | per-service time limit of `vg doctor` reachability checks |

## `llm`

LLM for the worker agents. provider: ollama ($0, local) | openai | groq (free plan) | openai_compat (any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. Gemini or OpenRouter) | mock ($0, CI)

| Key | Default | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `llm.provider` | `ollama` | ollama \| openai \| groq \| openai_compat \| mock |  |
| `llm.model` | `qwen2.5:3b` | text | Intel Mac, 16 GB RAM, CPU only: 3b is the practical size (7b is far slower) |
| `llm.base_url` | `http://localhost:11434` | text |  |
| `llm.temperature` | `0.0` | number (>= 0.0, <= 2.0) |  |
| `llm.seed` | `42` | integer |  |
| `llm.top_p` | `1.0` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) |  |
| `llm.max_output_tokens` | `800` | integer (> 0) | reasoning models (gpt-oss, gpt-6-*) count reasoning tokens here: raise it if replies are cut off |
| `llm.context_window` | `8192` | integer (> 0) | Ollama num_ctx |
| `llm.timeout_s` | `180` | number (> 0.0) |  |
| `llm.retry_backoff_s` | `1.0` | number (>= 0.0) | first pause between retries; doubles each attempt, capped by max_retry_wait_s |
| `llm.max_retries` | `2` | integer (>= 0) | retries on connection errors, 5xx and (hosted providers) 429 |
| `llm.json_repair_attempts` | `1` | integer (>= 0) | re-ask once if the output fails schema validation |
| `llm.max_retry_wait_s` | `60` | number (>= 0.0) | longest Retry-After (HTTP 429) the client will wait for; a longer one fails at once |
| `llm.openai.base_url` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | text |  |
| `llm.openai.model` | `gpt-6-luna` | text | cheapest current OpenAI model on 2026-11-23; verify on the pricing page |
| `llm.openai.response_format` | `json_schema` | json_schema \| json_object | json_schema \| json_object (use json_object if the model rejects schemas) |
| `llm.openai.max_tokens_field` | `max_completion_tokens` | max_tokens \| max_completion_tokens |  |
| `llm.openai.omit_params` | `[]` | list of temperature \| top_p \| seed | request fields the model rejects, e.g. [temperature, top_p, seed] |
| `llm.openai.api_key` | (secret: set in `.env`) | secret | keep empty - set VG_LLM__OPENAI__API_KEY in .env |
| `llm.groq.base_url` | `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` | text |  |
| `llm.groq.model` | `openai/gpt-oss-20b` | text | cheapest production model with structured outputs on 2026-11-23 |
| `llm.groq.response_format` | `json_schema` | json_schema \| json_object |  |
| `llm.groq.max_tokens_field` | `max_completion_tokens` | max_tokens \| max_completion_tokens |  |
| `llm.groq.omit_params` | `[]` | list of temperature \| top_p \| seed |  |
| `llm.groq.api_key` | (secret: set in `.env`) | secret | keep empty - set VG_LLM__GROQ__API_KEY in .env |
| `llm.openai_compat.base_url` | `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/` | text | Gemini; or OpenRouter etc. |
| `llm.openai_compat.model` | `gemini-2.5-flash` | text | verify the provider's current model name |
| `llm.openai_compat.response_format` | `json_schema` | json_schema \| json_object |  |
| `llm.openai_compat.max_tokens_field` | `max_tokens` | max_tokens \| max_completion_tokens |  |
| `llm.openai_compat.omit_params` | `[]` | list of temperature \| top_p \| seed |  |
| `llm.openai_compat.api_key` | (secret: set in `.env`) | secret | keep empty - set VG_LLM__OPENAI_COMPAT__API_KEY in .env |

## `decision`

Decision layer used by the triage and verify gates. provider: rule ($0) | llm_judge ($0 with Ollama) | jev (paid, tiny cost) | mock

| Key | Default | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision.provider` | `rule` | rule \| llm_judge \| jev \| mock |  |
| `decision.triage_threshold` | `0.6` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | confidence needed to mark NO_EVIDENCE without an LLM call |
| `decision.verify_threshold` | `0.7` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | confidence needed to accept a finding without review |
| `decision.rule.triage_min_keyword_hits` | `2` | integer (>= 0) |  |
| `decision.rule.triage_min_retrieval_score` | `0.15` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) |  |
| `decision.rule.verify_min_keyword_coverage` | `0.3` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) |  |
| `decision.rule.unsure_confidence` | `0.5` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | confidence of a near miss or an embedding-only match (never skipped: below triage_threshold) |
| `decision.rule.partial_signal_phrases` | `[where feasible, where possible, in progress, being rolled out, plann…` | list of text |  |
| `decision.rule.negative_signal_phrases` | `[not currently, does not, do not, is not enforced, not enforced, not …` | list of text |  |
| `decision.jev.base_url` | `https://api.typesafe.ai` | text | TypeSafe System One API (key from console.typesafe.ai/keys) |
| `decision.jev.path` | `/v1/systemone` | text | POST {base_url}{path}; for OpenRouter use base_url https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha, path /decisions, model typesafe/jev-1.13 |
| `decision.jev.model` | `jev-1.14.0` | text | pinned for reproducible evaluations; "jev-latest" is the moving alias (docs.typesafe.ai, 2026-11-25) |
| `decision.jev.timeout_s` | `15` | number (> 0.0) |  |
| `decision.jev.max_calls_per_run` | `200` | integer (> 0) |  |
| `decision.jev.fallback_provider` | `rule` | rule \| llm_judge \| mock | used automatically if Jev fails or no key is set |
| `decision.jev.yes_threshold` | `0.5` | number (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | P(yes) at or above this counts as a yes |
| `decision.jev.api_key` | (secret: set in `.env`) | secret | keep empty - set VG_DECISION__JEV__API_KEY in .env |
